# ToolTest

> A review board where engineers rate and review the AI coding tools, MCP
> servers, and agent skills they've actually used in production.

Teams are adopting AI coding tools faster than they can evaluate them, and
existing MCP/tool directories (Anthropic's own registry, Glama, Smithery,
PulseMCP) are crawled or claimed catalogs, not review platforms. ToolTest
is the review layer: star ratings and written reviews from real usage,
each tied to a verified GitHub identity so a rating can't be posted
anonymously or as someone else. Tools are organized by category (IDE
plugin, CLI, MCP server, agent skill) and can be filtered and browsed
from the home page.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://tooltest.co/): Browse and filter the tool catalog by
  category.
- Tool detail pages (`/tools/[slug]`): A specific tool's description,
  average rating, and reviews, with a form to submit a new review
  (requires GitHub sign-in).

## Technical implementation

- **Framework:** Next.js (Pages Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Auth:** NextAuth with GitHub OAuth; every review is attributed to the
  reviewer's authenticated GitHub account server-side, never to a
  client-submitted name
- **Database:** PostgreSQL
- **State management:** React Query

Source and full documentation: https://github.com/Younique98/agentradar
